name: 44138 · Olmsted Falls, OH
findings: ZIP 44138 (Olmsted Falls) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44138 (Olmsted Falls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44138 (Olmsted Falls) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
